_style: Drawn as a clean 3D game-asset concept render in a stylised anime background-art style: simple confident shapes, flat hand-painted colours with one soft shadow tone, crisp edges, no photographic noise. The WHOLE object is in frame with margin on every side, centred on a plain pure white background. Soft even studio light, no cast shadow on the ground, no reflections, no people, no text, no lettering, no writing in any language, no numbers, no logos, no brand badges, no watermark.
CafeSign: A projecting shop sign for a cafe, the kind that sticks out sideways from a wall above a door, 1.6 metres wide and 1 metre tall. A black wrought-iron bracket arm with a scroll, fixed to a small wall plate at the far left, and hanging under the arm a thick oval wooden sign board in cream with a teal border and a simple painted coffee cup with a curl of steam in the middle. No words. Seen straight from the front so the flat face of the board is toward the viewer and the arm runs left to right.
CafeChair: A cafe dining chair, 92 centimetres tall with a 44 centimetre square seat: a sturdy bistro chair in warm honey-coloured wood with a round-cornered seat padded in teal fabric, a curved backrest with three thick vertical slats, and four thick legs joined by a cross brace. Thick simple parts. Seen from a three-quarter front view slightly above eye level.
CafeTable: A small square cafe table, 74 centimetres wide and 76 centimetres tall: a thick honey-coloured wooden top with rounded corners on a single black cast-iron pedestal column with a heavy cross-shaped foot. Nothing on the table. Seen from a three-quarter view slightly above eye level.
CafeCounter: A long cafe service counter, one single straight rectangular block 5 metres long, 85 centimetres deep and 1.1 metres tall. The customer-facing front is panelled in vertical teal-painted wooden boards with a dark plinth along the bottom. The top is one thick, perfectly flat, completely empty slab of pale wood that overhangs slightly. Nothing at all on top. Plain panelled ends. Seen from a three-quarter front view slightly above eye level so the whole length is visible.
CafeShelf: A tall cafe back-bar shelving unit, 2 metres wide, 2.3 metres tall and 34 centimetres deep: an open dark wood bookcase with four shelves and a solid back panel, holding neat rows of chunky objects: stacks of white cups, glass jars of coffee beans, brown paper bags, a few teal tins, two small potted plants and plain bottles of syrup. No labels or writing on anything. Seen from the front, turned very slightly to one side.
CafeBanquette: A cafe banquette bench seat made to stand against a wall, straight and in one piece, 2.25 metres long, 72 centimetres deep and 1.08 metres tall: a thick padded seat and a tall buttoned padded backrest upholstered in teal leather, on a dark wooden base with short legs. Seen from a three-quarter front view slightly above eye level.
CafeBarCounter: A narrow cafe window bar ledge, 2.4 metres long, 32 centimetres deep and 1.05 metres tall: one thick honey-coloured wooden plank top carried on three black iron supports, each a slim leg to the floor with a triangular bracket under the plank. Nothing on it. Seen from a three-quarter front view slightly above eye level.
CafeChalkboard: A large framed cafe menu chalkboard made to hang on a wall, 2.4 metres wide and 1.7 metres tall, in a thick honey-coloured wooden frame. The black board is covered in white and pastel chalk drawings only: coffee cups, a croissant, a slice of cake, leaves, stars, and rows of wavy scribble lines that suggest handwriting but are not letters. No readable words and no numbers. Seen straight from the front.
CafePendant: A cafe pendant ceiling lamp, 95 centimetres tall in total: a dome-shaped metal shade in matte teal with a cream inside and a round warm glowing bulb, hanging from a thick black cord with a small round ceiling cup at the very top. A thick cord and simple shapes. Seen from the side, slightly below.
